SCO-001.name: Blade Knight
SCO-001.effect: Gains 400 ATK while you have 1 or less cards in your hand. If you control no other monsters, the effects of Flip monsters destroyed by battle with this card are negated.

individual.title: Other monsters you control
individual.text: If you control “Blade Knight” and a face-down monster on your side of the field, “Blade Knight”’s second effect is not applied because you control another monster (whether it is face-up or face-down is not important).

individual.title: Two Blade Knights
individual.text: If you have two “Blade Knights”, then their second effects are not applied because for each one, you have another monster on the field besides the “Blade Knight”.

individual.title: Interaction with Slate Warrior
individual.text: If “Blade Knight” destroys a Flip Effect Monster like “Slate Warrior”, even that monster’s non-Flip effects are negated. So in this case, “Slate Warrior” does not reduce the ATK and DEF of the “Blade Knight” that destroyed it, because “Blade Knight” negates its effect.

individual.title: Interaction with The Immortal of Thunder
individual.text: If “Blade Knight” destroys “The Immortal of Thunder”, its effect is negated. If your opponent had already gained the 3000 Life Points, then your opponent does not lose the 5000 Life Points. If “Blade Knight” attacked “The Immortal of Thunder” while it was face-down, your opponent neither gains nor loses Life Points from “The Immortal of Thunder”’s effect.

individual.title: Interaction with Spear Cretin
individual.text: If “Blade Knight” destroys “Spear Cretin”, “Spear Cretin”’s effect is not applied.

individual.title: Monster is Set again
individual.text: The effect of a Flip Effect monster destroyed by “Blade Knight” is negated while the destroyed card is in the Graveyard. If the monster is Set again on the field, then the Flip Effect is activated when it’s flipped again.

individual.title: Equal ATK and both monsters destroyed
individual.text: If “Blade Knight” attacks a face-down Attack Position Flip Effect Monster with equal ATK, and both monsters are destroyed, then “Blade Knight”’s effect is applied because it destroyed the monster, and the monster’s effect is negated.

SCO-002.name: Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning
SCO-002.image: images/cards/Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning.jpg
SCO-002.effect:
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK monster from your GY. Once per turn, you can activate 1 of these effects.

• Target 1 monster on the field; banish it. This card cannot attack the turn this effect is activated.

• If this attacking card destroys an opponent’s monster by battle: It can make a second attack in a row.

individual.title: Different from Black Luster Soldier
individual.text: “Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning” is treated as a different card from “Black Luster Soldier”. So you can have 3 copies of “Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning” and 3 copies of “Black Luster Soldier” in your Deck & Side Deck combined.

individual.title: Can banish itself
individual.text: “Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning” can remove itself from play using its first effect.

individual.title: Effect activation timing
individual.text: The first effect of “Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning” can be activated during your Main Phase 1 or 2. The second effect can be activated during your Damage Step in your Battle Phase, and can be chained to.

individual.title: Interaction with Skill Drain
individual.text: If you activate “Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning”’s first effect, and “Skill Drain” is chained to it to negate the effect, or if “Skill Drain” was active before you activated the effect, you cannot attack with “Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning” that turn because the activation of the effect was not negated and the condition that is included will not be negated by “Skill Drain”.

individual.title: Effect can be used again
individual.text: If you use the first effect of “Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning”, then remove him from play and return him to play, or destroy him and Special Summon him again, or flip him face-down then face-up again, you can activate his effect again that same turn.

individual.title: Attack negated
individual.text: If “Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning” attacks, and its attack is negated by “Magic Cylinder” or “Negate Attack”, you cannot activate his first effect during Main Phase 2.

individual.title: Cards are banished face-up
individual.text: When a card is removed from play by “Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning”’s first effect, it is removed from play face-up.

individual.title: Second attack can be direct
individual.text: If “Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning” destroys your opponent’s only monster with his first attack, he can attack your opponent directly for the second attack.

individual.title: Maximum attacks from its own effect
individual.text: If “Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning” attacks and destroys your opponent’s monster, then attacks a second time and destroys another monster, it does not get to attack any more that turn.

individual.title: Interaction with Twin Swords of Flashing Light - Tryce
individual.text: Even if you equip him with “Twin Swords of Flashing Light - Tryce”, “Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning” only gets a maximum of 2 attacks.

individual.title: Second attack must be consecutive
individual.text: When “Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning” conducts a second attack using his second effect, his effect activates during the first attack’s Damage Step, and the attack is declared in the next Battle Step. The second attack must come consecutively after the first attack; other monsters’ attacks cannot come in-between.

SCO-003.name: D.D. Warrior Lady
SCO-003.effect: After damage calculation, when this card battles an opponent’s monster: You can banish that monster, also banish this card.

individual.title: Effect is optional
individual.text: You don’t have to activate “D.D. Warrior Lady”’s effect if you don’t want to.

individual.title: Interaction with Fiber Jar
individual.text: When your “D.D. Warrior Lady” attacks your opponent’s “Fiber Jar”, if you activate her effect then “Fiber Jar” is Step 1 of the chain, because it is mandatory, and “D.D. Warrior Lady” is Step 2 of the chain because it is an optional effect. “D.D. Warrior Lady” removes from play both monsters, and then resolve the effect of “Fiber Jar”. “D.D. Warrior Lady” and “Fiber Jar” are not shuffled into the Deck.

individual.title: Interaction with Wall of Illusion
individual.text: When your “D.D. Warrior Lady” attacks “Wall of Illusion”, if you activate her effect then “Wall of Illusion” is Step 1 of the chain, because it is mandatory, and “D.D. Warrior Lady” is Step 2 of the chain because it is an optional effect. The effect of “D.D. Warrior Lady” removes from play both monsters, then the effect of “Wall of Illusion” disappears, since the attacking monster is no longer on the field.

individual.title: D.D. Warrior Lady vs. D.D. Warrior Lady
individual.text: If your “D.D. Warrior Lady” attacks your opponent’s “D.D. Warrior Lady”, your “D.D. Warrior Lady” is Step 1 of the chain and your opponent’s is Step 2, and when Step 2 resolves, both “D.D. Warrior Lady” cards are removed from play and your “D.D. Warrior Lady”’s effect disappears. This ruling would also apply to attacking “Kelbek”.

netrep.title: Battle damage is not required
netrep.text: Any time “D.D. Warrior Lady” is involved in battle, the controller of “D.D. Warrior Lady” may use its effect, regardless of if it inflicts damage.

netrep.title: Effect negation after battle
netrep.text: If “D.D. Warrior Lady” is destroyed by “Dark Ruler Ha Des”, “Dark Balter the Terrible,” or a monster equipped with “Wicked Breaking Flamberge – Baou,” “D.D. Warrior Lady” will not receive its effect.

netrep.title: Effect does not target
netrep.text: “D.D. Warrior Lady’s” effect is not targeting.

netrep.title: Interaction with Skill Drain
netrep.text: If “Skill Drain” is active when “D.D. Warrior Lady’s” effect resolves, the effect of “D.D. Warrior Lady” is negated.

SCO-004.name: Breaker the Magical Warrior
SCO-004.effect: If this card is Normal Summoned: Place 1 Spell Counter on it (max. 1). Gains 300 ATK for each Spell Counter on it. You can remove 1 Spell Counter from this card, then target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

individual.title: Spell Counter placement and Trap Hole
individual.text: Placing a Spell Counter on “Breaker, the Magical Warrior” is a chain that begins after it is Summoned. If your opponent chains “Trap Hole” or “Ring of Destruction” to the placement of a Spell Counter on “Breaker, the Magical Warrior”, “Trap Hole” / “Ring of Destruction” resolves before the Spell Counter is placed on “Breaker, the Magical Warrior”, so you cannot chain “Breaker, the Magical Warrior”’s effect.

individual.title: Effect is Spell Speed 1
individual.text: “Breaker, the Magical Warrior”’s effect is Spell Speed 1 so you cannot chain it to the activation of a Spell Card.

individual.title: Using the effect multiple times
individual.text: You can use “Breaker, the Magical Warrior”’s effect multiple times in the same turn as long as you can keep re-supplying him with Spell Counters (using “Pitch-Black Power Stone”, etc.).

individual.title: Removing the Spell Counter is a cost
individual.text: Removing a Spell Counter is a cost; if you remove a Spell Counter from “Breaker, the Magical Warrior” and your opponent chains “Ring of Destruction”, the Spell Counter has already been removed so “Ring of Destruction” deals 1600 damage to each player; “Breaker, the Magical Warrior”’s effect that destroys a card is still applied even though “Breaker, the Magical Warrior” himself has been destroyed at that point.

individual.title: Ring of Destruction during counter placement
individual.text: If I chain “Ring of Destruction” to the placement of a Spell Counter on “Breaker, the Magical Warrior”, “Ring of Destruction” does 1600 damage to each player because the action of placing the Spell Counter has not resolved.

netrep.title: Spell Counter only on Normal Summon
netrep.text: “Breaker the Magical Warrior” only receives its Spell Counter when it is Normal Summoned.

netrep.title: Flip and Special Summon
netrep.text: “Breaker the Magical Warrior” does not get its Spell Counter when it is Flip Summoned or Special Summoned.

netrep.title: Response to Normal Summon
netrep.text: When “Breaker the Magical Warrior” is Normal Summoned, the placement of the Spell Counter is the event to be chained to with “Trap Hole”, “Bottomless Trap Hole,” “Ring of Destruction,” etc.

netrep.title: Removing the counter is a Cost Effect
netrep.text: The removal of the Spell Counter on “Breaker the Magical Warrior” is a Cost Effect. It is Speed 1 and may not be chained to any other effect.

netrep.title: No Spell or Trap on the field
netrep.text: “Breaker the Magical Warrior’s” effect may not be activated if there are no Spell or Trap cards on the field.

SCO-005.name: Asura Priest
SCO-005.effect: Cannot be Special Summoned. During the End Phase of the turn this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: Return it to the hand. This card can attack all monsters your opponent controls once each.

individual.title: Direct attack
individual.text: “Asura Priest” may attack directly if it has not already attacked a monster this turn.

individual.title: Monster appears after a direct attack
individual.text: “Asura Priest” cannot attack a monster if it has already attacked directly this turn. For example, the opponent activates “Call of the Haunted” or “Scapegoat” after “Asura Priest” has completed a direct attack.

individual.title: Each monster only once
individual.text: “Asura Priest” may attack each monster only once. If the opponent controls “Spirit Reaper” you cannot continually attack it.

individual.title: Gravekeeper’s Servant and Toll
individual.text: When cards like “Gravekeeper’s Servant” or “Toll” are active on the field, you must pay each time “Asura Priest” attacks.

individual.title: Resolve each battle separately
individual.text: “Asura Priest” attacks each monster one a time. Resolve the battle with one monster before declaring an attack on another monster.

individual.title: Does not have to attack every monster
individual.text: “Asura Priest” does not have to attack all monsters on your opponent’s side of the field. If you opponent controls 3 monsters, you may choose to attack only 2 of them.

individual.title: Monsters Special Summoned during battle
individual.text: When “Asura Priest” attacks and destroys “Giant Rat” or “Masked Dragon”, you may then attack the monster Special Summoned by the effect of those monsters.

individual.title: Other monsters may attack directly
individual.text: After “Asura Priest” has attacked monsters, other monsters you control may still attack directly.

individual.title: Attacks do not have to be consecutive
individual.text: “Asura Priest” can attack each monster once during the same Battle Phase. These attacks do not have to be all in a row. For example, you can attack monsters with “Asura Priest”, then attack with another monster, and “Asura Priest” can still attack again as long as it attacks a monster it has not attacked yet.

netrep.title: Returning to the hand
netrep.text: “Asura Priest” does not return to the player’s hand if it is not face-up on the field during the End Phase of the turn it was turned face-up.

netrep.title: Direct attack restriction
netrep.text: The ‘you cannot attack your opponent directly’ text on “Asura Priest” refers specifically to an “Asura Priest” that has already attacked a monster on the opponent’s field. If “Asura Priest” has attacked a monster, that “Asura Priest” may not attack Life Points directly.

netrep.title: Separate Battle Steps
netrep.text: Each of “Asura Priest’s” attacks are separate Battle Steps.

SCO-006.name: Don Zaloog

netrep.title: Effect is optional
netrep.text: The effect of “Don Zaloog” is not mandatory.

netrep.title: Attacking or being attacked
netrep.text: “Don Zaloog’s” effect triggers if it inflicts Battle Damage, regardless of if it is attacking or is attacked.

netrep.title: Interaction with Witch of the Black Forest
netrep.text: If “Don Zaloog” attacks and destroys “Witch of the Black Forest” and inflicts Battle Damage, “Don Zaloog’s” effect will resolve first as it triggers on Battle Damage.
